newsitem.title: USA: Cinergy expands energy trading operations.
newsitem.headline: Cinergy expands energy trading operations.

text.p: Cinergy Capital and Trading Inc said it acquired the assets of Greenwich Energy Partners for an undisclosed amount of cash.
The Cinergy Corp unit said the acquisition continues its efforts toward becoming one of the top five worldwide energy trading firms.
Greenwich Energy, a limited partnership based in Greenwich, Conn., specializes in energy risk management, marketing, and proprietary arbitrage trading.
Prior to this transaction, the partnership was a member of the New York Mercantile Exchange.
As a result of the acquisition, Cinergy becomes one of the first major electric utilities to become a member of the NYMEX, it said.
The acquisition is expected to be immediately accretive to Cinergy's earnings, said J. Wayne Leonard, president of Cinergy Capital and Trading Inc and Cinergy's Energy Commodities Business Unit.

"It's clear that electric and gas markets are converging, and energy marketers need the capability to deliver not only multiple, physical commodities, but also the ability to provide and manage complex financial derivatives," Leonard said. "This is where Wall Street meets Main Street. Greenwich brings to Cinergy an elite team of people who are recognized in both the financial markets and in the energy industry for their expertise in commodity markets. They also have developed and will bring state-of-the-art information systems to analyze and execute trades."
